name: Atmospheric Parameterization
definition: Assumptions: 1. Light source is far (parallel rays). 2. Planet is spherical. 3. Density changes with altitude only. 4. Atmosphere is spherical shell symmetrical around plane between L and zenith at $P_O$.
summary: Atmospheric Parameterization remaps four-dimensional scattering data into a 3D texture using non-linear mappings to optimize sampling density for efficient real-time sky rendering.
